A line-break-only emphasis nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
